a: The Students module holds every learner’s profile — identity, guardian, medical, transport and fee status. Use “Add student” for a full multi-section intake form, or open any record for academic history and downloadable report cards.
Admissions manages applications from enquiry to enrolment. The Enrolment CRM tracks leads through New → Contacted → Toured → Application → Won, with follow-ups and conversion.
Staff & HR covers employee profiles, departments, onboarding and leave requests. Payroll handles salaries and payslips.
Parents lists guardians linked to each student, with contacts and communication tools.
Attendance lets you mark and review daily attendance by class, with present/absent KPIs and below-90% review flags.
Exams & Gradebook records marks and grades. Enter marks and generate downloadable report cards from a student’s profile.
Fees & Invoicing tracks tuition, transport and activity charges with paid/due/overdue status. Record payments and download fee statements (which include the local tax framework).
Timetable shows the weekly class schedule grid, colour-coded by subject.
Classes & Sections manages grade sections, streams, class teachers and capacity.
Curriculum organises subjects into units, terms and learning outcomes.
Learning (LMS) hosts courses, assignments and quizzes for blended learning.
Behaviour logs merits and incidents to track conduct over time.
Health & Clinic records clinic visits, reasons and actions taken, plus medical alerts.
Cafeteria manages meal plans and student wallets — you can top up a wallet balance.
Library manages the catalogue, book issues and returns. Add titles and issue books to members.
Transport covers routes, fleet vehicles and riders. Add routes and vehicles to the fleet.
Hostel manages boarding blocks and room/bed allocation.
Inventory tracks stock items, quantities and reorder levels.
Biometric Sync manages attendance devices and their sync status.
Visitor Management logs visitor check-ins, purpose and host.
Facilities & Bookings lets you reserve halls, labs and other facilities.
Helpdesk manages support tickets by category and priority.
Communication sends announcements and messages to parents and staff across channels.
Events Calendar schedules school events, holidays and parent-teacher meetings.
Surveys & Feedback creates polls and collects responses from your community.
Certificates issues official documents — transfer, bonafide and character certificates — as downloadable, print-ready files.
Alumni maintains records of graduates and their current paths.
Expenses logs operational spending by category and vendor.
Payroll handles staff salaries and payslips.
Reports & Analytics and AI Insights surface trends across attendance, finance and performance. The Dashboard gives an at-a-glance overview.
Roles & Access controls what each role can see and do via a permission matrix. You can add custom roles.
Audit Log records system activity for accountability and compliance.
Open Settings → Appearance to switch Light, Dark or System themes and pick a brand accent — or use the moon icon in the top bar. Your choice is saved on this device.

SchoolOS supports English, Arabic, Urdu and Hindi — with right-to-left layout for Arabic and Urdu. Use the language button in the top bar, or Settings → Region & localization. Your choice is remembered.

Settings → Data & compliance shows the privacy framework, authority, data residency and tax treatment for the selected country (India DPDP, UAE/Saudi PDPL, GDPR, FERPA…) and the regional grading system.
Settings → Region & localization adapts currency, language, direction and the grading/compliance framework across India, the GCC and global regions.
Many modules support export — the Students list exports to CSV, and report cards, fee statements and certificates download as print-ready documents.
Press ⌘K / Ctrl-K (or click the search bar) to open the command palette and jump to any module or action.
Use the role pill in the top bar to switch between Administrator, Principal, Teacher, Accountant, Parent and Student views — navigation and data adapt to each role.

I’m the SchoolOS assistant. I help you navigate this platform — ask about any area (students, fees, attendance, exams, timetable, HR, transport, compliance, themes, languages…) and I’ll explain it and open the right screen for you. I only cover Solvagence SchoolOS.
